Simulate a Population

Source: R/simulation.R
simulate_pop.Rd

Simulates a population of individuals split into groups across multiple sectors. Supports sector-level abundance covariate modeling via n_formula and named coefficient vectors n_betas, or user-provided sector covariates.

Usage

simulate_pop(
  pop_size,
  mean_group,
  tot_areas,
  area_sizes = NULL,
  n_formula = NULL,
  n_betas = NULL,
  covariates = NULL,
  n_cov_effect = 0
)

Arguments

pop_size

Average total population size (Poisson distributed).

mean_group

Average group size (Poisson distributed).

tot_areas

Total number of survey sectors.

area_sizes

Vector of relative probabilities/sizes for assigning groups to sectors. If NULL, probabilities are computed from n_formula and n_betas (or n_cov_effect).

n_formula

Optional one-sided formula for sector abundance covariates (e.g. ~ elevation + forest or ~ elevation * forest).

n_betas

Optional named numeric vector of log-linear coefficients for terms in n_formula (e.g., c(elevation = 0.5, forest = -0.3)).

covariates

Optional data frame of sector-level covariates containing tot_areas rows. If omitted, any variables specified in n_formula are simulated as standard normal variates.

n_cov_effect

Optional numeric log-linear slope for a single simulated habitat covariate (retained for backward compatibility; equivalent to n_formula = ~ habitat, n_betas = c(habitat = n_cov_effect)).

Value

A list containing:

tot_pop

Total simulated individuals (scalar).

sim_pop

List of groups per sector.

covariates

Data frame of sector-level covariates (one row per sector).

habitat

Numeric vector of the habitat covariate (if present).
